title: Staff
description: The employees of each branch: file number, position, agreed pay, what we owe them (or they owe) and the goods they took. Salaries are paid in "Payroll".

columns.name: Name
columns.balanceHint: What the employee owes for advances, or what we owe from a salary left unpaid
columns.payToDateHint: Agreed salary + overtime to pay − advances and goods. Paying the payroll brings it back to the salary; what was not settled carries over.

status.advanced: Advance of {{amount}} to {{name}} recorded: it left the till and is deducted from the next payroll.

form.description: File data and pay. Not the legal payroll (contributions, official payslip): the accountant keeps doing that.
form.roleHint: Positions are managed in Lookup tables → Positions.
form.payHint: The base amount proposed in every payroll of its frequency. Overtime, bonuses, SAC, etc. are added in each payroll.
form.takesGoods: Takes goods (registered in the web or sold at the POS on account, and deducted from the salary)
form.takesGoodsHint: A customer «Last, First (personal)» is created: goods are registered in the web ("Goods") or sold at the POS on account. At payroll, what they owe is deducted from the salary with the discount you decide then, per product and on the total.

errors.name: Enter last and first name.
errors.salary: The pay is an amount with up to two decimals (or empty).
errors.file: The file number is a whole number above zero.
errors.overtimeRate: Type a value above zero with at most two decimals, or leave it empty.

form.overtimeHourlyRateHint: For overtime: hours × this rate × the multiplier (Sunday ×2). Empty: no overtime can be recorded.

advance.title: Advances of {{name}}
advance.description: The money leaves the Treasury account you choose and stays on the employee's account: the next payroll deducts it. An advance entered by mistake is corrected or voided from the history, and the cash and the employee's account are corrected together.
advance.correctHint: The advance of {{date}} for {{amount}} is voided and this one is recorded in its place.
advance.conceptPlaceholder: E.g.: on account of October's salary
advance.corrected: Advance corrected: the one of {{date}} was voided and the one for {{amount}} was recorded.
advance.voided: Advance of {{date}} voided: the money goes back to {{account}} and is no longer deducted.
advance.voidMessage: The advance of {{date}} for {{amount}} is voided: the money goes back to the account {{account}} and the payroll no longer deducts it. It stays in the history, struck through, with the reason.

errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, with up to two decimals.
errors.account: Choose the account the money comes from.
errors.load: The advances could not be loaded.
errors.range: The From date must be on or before the To date.

codes.advance-in-payroll-draft: {{name}} is in a draft payroll that already deducts their advances. Delete the draft or take them out of it, then void or correct the advance.

errors.load: The staff could not be loaded.
errors.save: It could not be saved. Try again.

codes.file-number-in-use: Another employee has that file number.
codes.account-not-found: That treasury account does not exist.
codes.overtime-rate-missing: The employee has no overtime hourly rate: set it in its details.
codes.overtime-settled: That overtime is already in a payroll: change it there.

overtime.title: Overtime of {{name}}
overtime.description: Recorded when worked: hours × the overtime hourly rate × the multiplier. The next payroll takes the pending ones by itself.
overtime.noRate: Set the overtime hourly rate in the employee details ("Edit") to record overtime.
overtime.multiplierHint: A Sunday proposes ×2; any other day ×1. It can be changed (1 to 3).
overtime.loadError: The overtime could not be loaded.
overtime.deleteMessage: Delete the overtime of {{date}} ({{hours}} h)? Only if it was recorded by mistake.

errors.hours: Type the hours: more than 0 and up to 24, with at most two decimals.
errors.multiplier: Type a multiplier from 1 to 3, with at most two decimals.
errors.date: Pick a day that already passed (or today).

goods.title: Goods taken by {{name}}
goods.description: What the employee takes, like a counter sale: at the Mostrador list price, out of stock and onto their account. The next payroll deducts it from the salary, with the discount you decide there.
goods.noAccount: Takes no goods. To register some, turn on "Takes goods" in their details ("Edit").
goods.invalidInteger: This product is sold by the unit: enter a whole number.
goods.loadError: The goods could not be loaded.
goods.quoteError: The prices could not be calculated. Try again.

codes.employee-no-goods-account: Takes no goods: turn on "Takes goods" in their details to register some.
codes.no-effective-price: A product has no effective price on the Mostrador list for that date.
codes.goods-key-in-use: This entry was already used for another employee. Reopen the goods and enter it again.
codes.goods-settled: It cannot be voided: a paid payroll already deducted it.

goods.voidMessage: The goods of {{date}} for {{amount}} ({{products}}) are voided: the stock comes back, the charge on the account is reversed and the payroll does not deduct them.
goods.correctMessage: The goods of {{date}} for {{amount}} ({{products}}) are voided and their products go back to the form, to correct and register them again.
goods.voidedToCorrect: Goods voided: correct the products and register them again.

leave.title: Leave of {{name}}
leave.description: The leave is recorded with its date and reason. Then the last salary is settled through the same "Payroll" flow.
leave.settleHint: Prepares a draft with the salary in proportion to the days worked since the last paid payroll, the pending overtime, the advances and the goods. It is reviewed and paid in "Payroll".
leave.reinstateHint: If the employee comes back, reinstate it: the leave date and reason are cleared.

errors.reason: Type the reason of the leave.
errors.date: Pick a day that already passed (or today).

codes.employee-active: The employee is active: record the leave first.
codes.employee-in-draft: There is already a draft payroll for the employee: review it in "Payroll".
codes.employee-other-branch: Pick the employee's branch in the top bar to settle it.
codes.employee-already-settled: Its last salary is already settled.
codes.employee-in-payroll-draft: There is a draft payroll for the employee: pay or discard it before reinstating.
